title: emb-hwgen's outcome, format 1 (--format json, HW-002)
description: What one emb-hwgen command did, for tools and IDEs: its status and exit code, every finding with its file, line, node path and message apart, and the files it wrote. Format 1: a field added keeps the format, a field changed or removed bumps it.

status.description: ok (exit 0, warnings possible); errors (exit 2: the descriptions are wrong, or check found no boards/); stale (exit 1: check found generated files that differ, or hardware facts outside a description; generate left a merge conflict in an edited file, A126); internal-error (exit 3: the generator itself failed, see error)

files.description: generate: the files written, relative to the repository root

rule.description: HW-002 (a description error or warning), HW-001 (a hardware fact outside a description), HW-003 (a generated file out of date), or null

file.description: relative to the repository root, or absolute for a board outside it

path.description: the node in the description, dotted (console.baud, devices[2].cs), (root) or (file)

text.description: the finding as the text output prints it

diff.description: HW-003 only: a unified diff from the committed file to what emb-hwgen generates now
